Explain that Cloudron access control governs SSO access. Review comments at @README.md: - Around line 98-100: Update the README instructions for WARMBLY_OIDC_FIRST_USER_OWNER to tell operators to restart the app after setting the option and before proceeding to the setup-link instructions, since start.sh reads the environment only at startup. Review comments at @scripts/render-store-media.sh: - Line 19: Update the render flow around the output check so chromium writes to a fresh temporary file instead of the existing destination. Verify the temporary image was written successfully, then replace the destination only after that verification; leave the existing image untouched on failure. --- Nitpick comments: Review comments at @media/src/slide.html: - Line 28: Adjust the .frame dimensions and positioning, along with the related crop settings, so rendered slide content is not unintentionally hidden or clipped; check all five slides and the banner for missing images, clipped text, and unintended crops.
